::: {.bs-lesson-preamble}
TEJ is organized around a real computing environment: Linux, Git, Python, logic, data, and machine learning. Hardware ideas are learned through the systems students actually use rather than by repeatedly disassembling computers.
:::

<details class="bs-answer-panel" open>
<summary>Course outline</summary>
<div class="bs-answer-panel-content">

1. Starting Point
2. Linux & Computer Systems
3. Git, GitHub & Portfolio
4. Python Foundations
5. Logic & Digital Systems
6. Python, Data & DataFrames
7. Machine Learning
8. Major Project & Portfolio

</div>
</details>

<details class="bs-answer-panel">
<summary>How the course works</summary>
<div class="bs-answer-panel-content">

Students build the environment they will use, then use it to create software and data projects. Grade 12 work can extend into model comparison, tiny language models, and tool-connected AI systems as appropriate.

</div>
</details>
